Caching for FastAPI

FastAPI-CacheX

HTTP caching, an application cache and a distributed lock.

Memory
Redis
Memcached
$ pip install fastapi-cachex
main.py
@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
@cache(ttl=60)
async def read_item(item_id: int):
    return {"item_id": item_id}

# served from the cache for 60 s
# ETag → 304 Not Modified
